# Saved results

These tables use the committed JSON in `outputs/results/`. No models, image generation, or simulations were rerun.

## Pilot recovery

SD-Turbo; CLIP ViT-B/32; CPU; 256 × 256 images; two neutral subjects; one seed. Intervals are the saved item-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.

| Condition | Images | Accuracy | 95% CI | Macro-F1 | Shuffled-label p |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `raw` | 14 | 14.29% | 0.00%–35.71% | 0.0381 | 0.8566 |
| `emotion` | 14 | 21.43% | 0.00%–42.86% | 0.1122 | 0.2259 |
| `affect` | 14 | 21.43% | 0.00%–42.86% | 0.1333 | 0.1369 |
| `scene` | 7 | 28.57% | 0.00%–57.50% | 0.1837 | 0.1449 |

Uniform chance is 14.29% (1/7). The `scene` diagnostic uses fixed emotion scenes and is separate from the paired tiers. The pilot has no saved `naive` measurement. No tier has a shuffled-label p-value below .05.

## Partial recovery correction

Correction is estimable for 5/7 classes. Full seven-class corrected recovery is unavailable. The partial comparison covers anger, disgust, fear, joy, sadness.

| Scope | Apparent recovery | Corrected recovery |
|---|---:|---:|
| All seven classes | 21.43% | Unavailable |
| Five estimable classes | 10.00% | 16.51% |

Neutral has no validation support. The surprise probe is non-discriminating. The five-class estimate is not a correction of the full seven-class result.

## Illustrative planning simulation

Saved binomial mixture simulation: chance 14.29%, assumed probe ceiling 45.50%, α=0.05, target power 80%. It assumes independent trials and transfer of real-image validation accuracy to generated images. It uses a binomial null; the benchmark uses a fixed-label permutation null. These rows do not estimate the benchmark test's power.
